scope: Complete upstream repository with original relative layout, root LICENSE/NOTICE, and nested assets/licenses retained; installation metadata and workflows are inert vendored files.
method: Static safe-YAML parsing with duplicate-key detection, JSON/Python-AST parsing, Markdown/resource path checks, command-pattern review, and full SHA-256 plus Git blob SHA-1 verification. Targeted manual review of script side effects and publishing instructions. No upstream code executed.

validation.nameConstraints: All names are 1-64 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric/hyphen characters, without leading/trailing/repeated hyphens, and match their containing directory.
validation.descriptions: All parsed descriptions are nonempty strings of at most 1024 characters.

license.note: Retain Apache LICENSE/NOTICE and the font notice in redistribution. GitHub reported the pinned commit verified; the signature was not independently reverified locally.

resourceNotes.resolution: The sentence explicitly identifies love2d-core as the owner; resolve to skills/other-engines/love2d-core/references/state-stack.md, which exists.
Intentional authoring placeholders, not missing packaged skill resources.
Generated/copied by the build workflow, not missing vendored inputs. No remote SDK is included; the template comment leaves optional portal SDK integration to the project.
skills/<category>/<name>/SKILL.md paths are repository-relative rather than relative to router/. Resolve from this vendor root; load only selected skill bodies and on-demand references.

scriptReview.effects: Copies a starter into absent/empty --out and writes Go module/title values. --ci additionally writes .github/workflows/ci.yml and copies checker/packager helpers. No network or subprocess.
scriptReview.risk: The emitted CI workflow installs system dependencies and publishes GitHub releases on v* tags. Do not pass --ci or activate publication without explicit approval. go mod tidy/test/run and git commands are printed next steps, not executed by this script.

scriptReview.risk: Review --out, --name, inputs, local lipo executable and --force. No signing or notarization occurs in the script; printed signing/notarization instructions require separate authorization.

scriptReview.risk: Not an engine run; review symlink scope and input sizes before checking untrusted projects.

scriptReview.risk: ZIP member reads at lines 317-323 have no explicit decompressed-size bound. Inspect/limit archives and scan scope before using on untrusted projects.

scriptReview.effects: Read-only Unity source/meta/package checker; no network or subprocess.
scriptReview.risk: Local file: package references can point outside the selected project (lines 417-437), and caches/symlinks enlarge the read scope. Review these paths rather than treating the project root as a sandbox.

scriptReview.effects: Read-only VDF/depot/content checker; does not run SteamCMD, upload, log in, or read login files.

publishingAndInstallRisks.finding: Contains alternative-agent/global npx skills and marketplace installation instructions. Inert documentation/metadata only; not used to install this bundle and not permission to modify global skill configuration.

Upstream CI installs Pillow and runs tests/builds; Pages workflow uploads and deploys documentation with pages/id-token write permissions. Nested vendor workflows are inactive; never copy them into the host repository's root .github automatically.

Starter CI uses sudo apt-get, Go dependency/build tooling, artifact uploads, and softprops/action-gh-release on v* tags with contents:write. Actions are tag-pinned rather than immutable commit-pinned. These are opt-in external side effects, not part of vendoring.

Contains butler login/push, user credential-file locations, BUTLER_API_KEY, and curl download of a mutable LATEST binary ZIP followed by unzip/chmod/execute. No digest verification is shown. Actual installation, credential access, CI-secret handling, uploads or visibility changes require explicit separate authorization.

Contains SteamCMD self-update/login/uploads, credential/token paths, restoration of config.vdf from CI secrets, branch SetLive, and release steps. Review target account/app/depot/branch/content first; do not obtain or disclose credentials or upload/set live without explicit authorization.

Installation, signing/notarization, platform distribution and package-manager examples are instructional. Verify installed engine versions, toolchain compatibility, exact destinations, and user authorization before any execution.

limitations: Static AST parsing and targeted manual review do not establish absence of every vulnerability or hidden behavior.
The eight Python test modules were syntax-parsed but not imported or executed; they create fixtures and invoke helper subprocesses when run.
The Go starter was inspected for imports, file writes and web loading behavior but not compiled or run. Its screenshot option writes the requested path.
Read-only checkers can still consume excessive resources or follow project-controlled references outside a selected directory; they are not sandboxes.
External URLs, API baselines and every example's engine correctness were not exhaustively validated.
Preserve the target project's actual pinned engine/toolchain versions; upstream defaults (including Phaser 4.2.1) are not migration permission.
No installation scripts, package managers, npm/skills commands, credential operations, uploads, or global configuration changes were performed.
